pro_course_detail.title: English Speaking, Listening, Pronunciation, and Grammar (TEENS + ADULTS)
pro_course_detail.description:
This class is conversation-based, but I will correct your pronunciation, vocabulary, and grammar. There are 4 options:

1. No homework - just show up! You can choose what you would like to talk about, or I will choose topics to keep you talking :)

2. Video homework - I create homework assignment based on videos (usually Ted Talks). I pick out vocabulary from the video, especially phrasal verbs and other useful phrases, and we discuss the video topic in our next class.

3. Grammar homework - some students notice that they have "gaps" in their grammar knowledge and would like to reinforce certain topics. In that case, the class time will still be conversation-based, but I will spend some time explaining the grammar and will send you exercises to practice on your own.

4. Business English - I will provide a Business English book which will be used for your homework and the basis of our classes.

I accept students aged 13+. I prefer using Zoom for classes.

-Advanced vocabulary: Academic research terms, professional jargon.
